note: A listening exercise for a beginner: tap Do as home, tap the two chords that differ by one note, then name major or minor by ear. One staff per step, each showing only the notes that step names; the staff is explained the first time it appears.

exercise.title: Home, and the note that makes major or minor
exercise.focus: Do as home in C · 1-3-5 vs 1-♭3-5 · major or minor 3rd by ear
exercise.why: Hearing home and hearing major against minor are the two judgements every later ear skill builds on.

sections.text: The staff below shows the C major scale on the five lines of music. Tap a note to hear it. Tap {{1}}, then any other note, then {{1}} again. Try it with different notes. Which ones sound finished?
One note makes major or minor
Now tap {{1}} {{b3}} {{5}}: C minor. Only the middle note moved, by a half step. Switch between the two staffs. Then try it with your eyes closed.
The game plays two notes together: a major 3rd or a minor 3rd. Pick the one you heard.
